one_line_description.value: Zoho Cliq is a business communication platform for team chat, channels, calls, meetings, and workflow automation.
one_line_description.quote: Zoho Cliq streamlines your business communication and fuels effortless conversations within teams and external stakeholders through organization, automation, and AI.

has_public_api.quote: All of Cliq's APIs are documented in the OpenAPI specification, which can be downloaded as a YAML file below:

api_type.quote: Zoho Cliq's REST API is designed based on RESTful architecture principles, enabling seamless communication between your applications and Zoho Cliq.

api_breadth.value: Broad read-write REST surface: chats, channels, messages, threads, teams, bots, files, calendars, reminders, roles, plus v3 CRUD for bots, slash commands, message actions, widgets, and schedulers.
api_breadth.quote: v3 introduces CRUD API endpoints for bots, slash commands, message actions, widgets, schedulers, and more, which were not available in v2.

docs_url.quote: Every v3 endpoint follows a consistent model with resource-oriented URLs, JSON request/response bodies, standard HTTP verbs, and uniform error structures.

auth_methods.quote: Zoho Cliq API uses the OAuth 2.0 protocol for authentication.

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: Access tokens are always assigned specific scopes, which are outlined in the request, and these scopes will be presented to the user during the permission request process.

access_model.quote: Upon successful registration of your application, you will receive a Client ID and Client Secret. These credentials are used to obtain an access token, which is required to make API calls to Zoho Cliq.

access_notes.value: Credentials are self-serve: register an app in the Zoho API Console and receive a Client ID/Secret for OAuth. No plan tier, app review, partner approval, or sales contact gate for API credentials was documented in the fetched pages; the pricing comparison page was unreadable and Zoho Cliq advertises a 15-day free trial.
access_notes.quote: Go to the Zoho API Console, then click GET STARTED.

official_mcp_server.quote: The Zoho Cliq MCP Server brings your chats into the world of AI using the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

webhooks.quote: Their behavior is fully customizable through predefined Bot Handlers, which are activated by specific actions or through Webhooks that communicate with your own external server.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: URL-path versioning (/v2/, /v3/); v3 is the latest and recommended for new integrations; v2 remains documented and shares the same base domain and OAuth tokens. No deprecation/sunset timeline was found in the fetched evidence.
api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.quote: The latest version, v3, is the recommended choice for all new workflows, automations, and integrations.

verdict_reason: Zoho Cliq publishes a versioned REST API (v3) documented with an OpenAPI spec, OAuth 2.0 with scoped access tokens, and broad read-write coverage of chats, channels, messages, bots, and more. App registration and credential issuance are self-serve through the Zoho API Console, with no sales contact, partner approval, or app review documented for API access. Composio also ships a 162-tool Zoho Cliq toolkit, confirming practical integration breadth.
open_questions: The fetched plan-comparison page contained no readable pricing/plan-gating text; whether a paid Cliq plan is required for production API use is unconfirmed.
API rate limits/throttling quotas were not documented in the fetched REST API pages.
No documented sandbox or test environment was found; the Postman collection page appeared in search but was not included in the fetched evidence.
No official vendor-maintained SDKs were found; only Zoho Catalyst SDK pages appeared in search results, which are not Cliq-specific SDKs.
The Zoho Cliq MCP server is vendor-operated, but no public MCP endpoint URL was published in the fetched docs; it is likely per-organization/tenant.
The v2 deprecation/sunset policy was not found; the deprecations help page appeared in search but was not included in the fetched evidence.
No community/third-party MCP servers for Zoho Cliq were found (GitHub and MCP registry checks returned none).
